title: Tip from Angela - Dealing with Lack of Progress
summary: A motivational tip for learners who feel they are not progressing despite weeks of study.

concepts.heading: Key takeaways
points: Feeling that you know little is normal at any stage; nobody knows everything in even one technology, so learn what your goals need after the fundamentals.
Perceived difficulty stays roughly constant because the topics keep getting harder as you improve, which hides real progress.
To measure progress, revisit the Q&A from early sections and try answering beginners' questions. Being able to answer them shows how far you have come.
Answering those questions also reinforces your own knowledge.
